query: Under Japanese APPI, what lawful basis or institutional authority permits access to REC decision letters and reviewer comments, and what DPO approvals or notifications are required?

response.query: Under Japanese APPI, what lawful basis or institutional authority permits access to REC decision letters and reviewer comments, and what DPO approvals or notifications are required?
response.answer: Under Japanese APPI, access to REC decision letters and reviewer comments requires consent from the data subject. No DPO approvals or notifications are required for this access.

results.title: The SmartPOS app that actually makes sense - lidX
results.content: ##### **SoftPOS with lidX – Seamless integration with POS systems and receipts in over 100 languages**. ###### The lidX SmartPOS app is your all-in-one payment solution: SoftPOS, ZVT, OPI, cashback, acquirer integration, and 100+ languages – for Android. With lidX, you get one of the most flexible SmartPOS solutions for integrating POS systems into modern, software-based payment terminals. Thanks to support for established POS protocols such as ZVT, O.P.I., Nexo, SIX TIM, CB2, ep2, and other proprietary interfaces, lidX can be easily integrated into virtually any POS or ERP environment – whether stationary, mobile, or hybrid. Through this seamless integration into cash registers and receipt scenarios, lidX meets the highest requirements for interoperability, multi-tenancy, compliance, and internationalization – making it a future-proof choice for companies with high transaction volumes, multilingual teams, and a global customer base. ###### With SoftPOS, you can easily accept credit cards, debit cards, and alternative payment methods (APM) and offer your customers maximum payment flexibility.
